attributes.action: Require full prison terms for child killers
attributes.additional_details: I am calling on the UK Government to amend the law so that anyone convicted of causing the death of a child through a deliberate violent assault, whether convicted of murder or manslaughter, must serve the full custodial sentence imposed by the court, without automatic early release.
attributes.background: I want the Government to change the law so that anyone convicted of murder, or manslaughter involving a violent assault against a child, must serve the full custodial sentence imposed by the court, with no automatic early release.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign this petition which calls for the same action:

Ban ROTL & early release for offences related to death of a child
